external.title: Connect to rustuya-bridge
external.description: The MQTT broker your running rustuya-bridge uses, and the IL prefix to publish under. Setup checks that the bridge answers there. The rest (topic root, IL source, device file) starts at its default; change it later in the Rustuya panel's Settings.

data_description.il_prefix: Where the devices are published for il-ha (or any IL consumer); il-ha reads il by default.

embedded.title: Run rustuya-bridge here
embedded.description: This still connects to a real MQTT broker; it just launches and owns the bridge process itself instead of you running one separately. Its topic root, state file and log level start at their defaults; change them later in the Rustuya panel's Settings.

data_description.il_prefix: Where the devices are published for il-ha (or any IL consumer); il-ha reads il by default.

onboard.title: Devices
onboard.description: Log in to Tuya Cloud now to fetch your device list and register devices on the bridge. You can also do it later from the integration's Configure, or point at a device file rustuya-manager already keeps from the Rustuya panel's Settings.

menu_options.cloud_wizard_start: Log in to Tuya Cloud now

cloud_wizard_start.title: Log in to Tuya Cloud
cloud_wizard_start.description: Leave the user code blank for a fresh QR login, or enter a saved one to skip scanning again. To set up without logging in, close this window: Rustuya is added, and the login is in its Configure later.

cloud_wizard_scan.title: Scan the QR code
cloud_wizard_scan.description: Scan with the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app, then submit. Close this window to finish the setup without the login.

sync_devices.title: Sync devices with the bridge
sync_devices.description: Cloud list vs. what the bridge holds: {synced} in sync, {missing} missing from the bridge, {mismatched} with differing settings, {orphaned} on the bridge but not in the cloud list. Every device is listed with its state; nothing is changed unless you select it. {error}

data.update: Update on the bridge (push the cloud's settings)
data.remove: Remove from the bridge (any device it holds)

error.bridge_not_found: The broker answers, but no rustuya-bridge is running on that topic root. Start the bridge, or enter the topic root it runs on, and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the MQTT broker. Check the host, port and credentials.
error.invalid_prefix: An MQTT topic without wildcards (+, #) or empty levels, e.g. il or home/il.
error.publish_failed: Could not send the command to the bridge.
error.pyrustuyabridge_missing: pyrustuyabridge is not installed; pick an external bridge instead

abort.manager_busy: Another Tuya login or device sync window is still open. Close it and try again.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Rustuya is already set up; it runs as a single instance.
